info.name: Adventuring Gear and Gels
info.description: Adventuring Gear and Gels from the Aldea Campaign Setting.

description.p: Using recipes found in ancient Ovrim texts, alchemists of Aeretz have learned to create restorative gels by combining the pulp of certain Aeretzian fruits with arcane-infused powders. Some of these gels can catalyze great feats of physical endurance, while others can restore a portion of one's expended magical capabilities.

A creature can consume a gel as an Action. However, a creature can only consume a number of gels equal to their Proficiency Bonus, after which they must complete a Short Rest before they can consume more. Consuming a higher rank gel is equivalent to consuming a number of gels equal to its rank.
This particular gel is crafted from the famously-tart tannimon fruit. Upon consumption, the creature can immediately expend 1 Hit Die to recover a single spell slot of Level 1 or lower.
